publishedRecipe.name: Spicy Peanut Pork Stir-Fry with Bok Choy, Mango & Broccoli Slaw

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic; place in a medium bowl.
Add soy sauce, oil, and crushed red pepper to the bowl with the garlic; whisk to combine the marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 tsp soy sauce
2 tsp toasted sesame oil
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Slice pork chops crosswise into ½-inch thick strips, add to the bowl with the marinade, toss to coat, and set aside.
While the pork marinates, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
1 lime
6 baby bok choy
2 mangoes

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, peel and mince ginger; place in a small bowl.
Juice lime into the bowl with the ginger; add peanut butter, fish sauce, water, honey, and spices. Whisk to combine the peanut sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup natural peanut butter
2 tbsp fish sauce
2 tbsp water
4 tsp honey
½ tsp turmeric, ground
¼ tsp curry powder
¼ tsp coriander, ground

instructions.primary_message: Place oil, soy sauce, vinegar, honey, and chili-garlic sauce in a large bowl; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
4 tsp soy sauce
2 tsp rice vinegar
2 tsp honey
1 tsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pork strips and marinade; stir-fry until browned and cooked through, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim and thinly slice bok choy crosswise into shred-like strips; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel mangoes and slice flesh away from the pits, starting with the flat sides; large dice and add to the bowl.
Add broccoli slaw to the bowl and toss to combine.
When the pork is done, add peanut sauce, stir to combine, and cook until sauce is warmed through and pork is coated, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pork stir-fry and slaw between plates. Sprinkle pork with additional crushed red pepper and enjoy!
